title: BWOC agent manifest
description: config.manifest.json for an incarnated BWOC agent. Camel-cased fields mirror bwoc-core's Manifest. Editor assistance only — `bwoc check` remains the source of truth for backend-neutrality and completeness.

name.description: Agent name (kebab-case). agentId is derived as agent-<name>.

primaryModel.description: Primary LLM model identifier, or the literal "auto" to let the harness pick from autoModels at runtime.

autoModels.description: Candidate model pool (preference order) used when primaryModel is "auto". For OpenAI-compatible endpoints put frontier models first and cheaper fallbacks later.

reasoningEffort.description: Optional backend effort control. Backend-neutral field; the value space is backend-specific (Claude: low|medium|high|xhigh|max; OpenAI-compatible: e.g. low|medium|high|xhigh). Backends without effort control ignore it.

maxTokens.description: Optional output-token ceiling. Claude requires max_tokens and uses this instead of the harness default; OpenAI-compatible backends send it as max_tokens when set.

promptCache.description: Provider prompt caching (default on). Set false for a volatile system prompt.

thinking.description: Adaptive extended thinking (default off). When true the native Claude path requests thinking:{type:adaptive} and replays thinking blocks across turns.

sessionsPath.description: Session data directory for Tier 2 memory mining.

lintCmd.description: Lint command for the verification gate.

formatCmd.description: Format command for the verification gate.

testCmd.description: Test command for the verification gate.

buildCmd.description: Build command for the verification gate.

outOfScope.description: What this agent explicitly does not do.

backend.description: LLM backend adapter. Leave unset to use the workspace/registry default.

cliCmd.description: Override the backend CLI command (for CLI-driven backends).

baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint base URL (include /v1 if the provider requires it).

trust.description: Trust-v2 block: declared qualities, required trust of senders, and refusal mode.

declared.description: Kalyāṇamitta qualities this agent claims. Missing → false.

requiredTrust.description: Qualities a sender must declare to be accepted. Empty → refusal mode Off.

mode.description: Refusal mode. Empty requiredTrust → off; non-empty → refuse. warn is strictly opt-in.

signingPublicKey.description: ed25519 public key (hex). Written by `bwoc trust --keygen`; the private key stays in .bwoc/agent.key.

skills.description: Enabled skills grouped by source (e.g. "framework"). Each source maps to a list of skill entries.
